set system host-name SSH_Server.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login user huawei123.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication plaintext-password \"$1c$.explanation: Configure the password for the system to log in to the user.

set system services ssh protocol-version.command: set system services ssh protocol-version v2
set system services ssh protocol-version.explanation: Configure the protocol version used for SSH services.

parameters.name: protocol-version
parameters.explanation: SSH protocol version, v2 indicates use of SSH version 2.

set system services ssh root-login deny.command: set system services ssh root-login deny
set system services ssh root-login deny.explanation: Configure SSH services, prohibiting root users from login.

parameters.name: root-login
parameters.explanation: Whether or not to control root users can log in through SSH and Deny says no.

set system services ssh authentication-o.command: set system services ssh authentication-order password
set system services ssh authentication-o.explanation: Configure the authentication order for SSH services.

set system services ssh interface ge-0/0.command: set system services ssh interface ge-0/0/0.0
set system services ssh interface ge-0/0.explanation: Configure the interface attached to the SSH service.

set system login user root.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication-order password.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system login user.

set security ipv6 access-list 2000.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv6 access control list (ACL) named `[parameter1]` in Junos, defining rules for filtering IPv6 traffic based on specified criteria.

term 1.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv6 access control list (ACL) by defining a term (rule) within the specified ACL, identified by `[parameter1]` and `[parameter2]`.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: Access the item number of the control list.

then accept.explanation: Configure actions for IPv6 access control lists.

set security forwarding-options family i.explanation: This command enables forwarding for a specific protocol family (e.g., `inet` for IPv4 or `inet6` for IPv6) in the security zone for traffic processing.

generate-crypto-key rsa modulus 2048.explanation: Configure the RSA encryption key for IPv6 forward options.

parameters.name: modulus
parameters.explanation: Number of model lengths for RSA keys.
